subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
statement: When a process is launched for a task, the system shall record that process's ordinal position within the task and the occasion that launched it.
rationale: J3 asks which work was rework; role alone cannot answer it, since a first-pass process and a CI-fix process share the role recorded by FR-7
fit_criterion: for a multi-process task in the checkpoint batch, each record carries a distinct ordinal and an occasion drawn from the closed set {first-pass, ci-fix, review-remediation, resume}, and a consumer can identify the first-pass process without reading any other record
